finding: Mirroring recovers both mirror anchor transforms in 5/5 sources; no unrelated-source positives. Rotation 90 is missed in 5/5 sources, central crop missed in 4/5. Mirror near-only TP84 FP0 FN46.
decision: Add explicit includeRotations option, default false. Compute 0/90/180/270-degree pixel-coordinate dHashes in MoonBit; optionally include their horizontal mirrors. Index ordinary Hamming variants, deduplicate pairs, report contributing left/right orientations; all extra index/verification distances consume finite work. No threshold change, no crop claim.
acceptance: Independent coordinate/pixel and exhaustive pair oracle; budget and duplicate tests. Evaluate untouched source holdout once implementation and tests are fixed; report all regressions and extra work. Do not tune threshold or orientation set on holdout.
